paper_title: Axion dark matter search from terrestrial magnetic fields at extremely low frequencies
coupling_convention: canonical g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Axion-photon coupling search using terrestrial ELF magnetic field data (0.3-30 Hz, ma 1e-15 to 1e-13 eV) at Eskdalemuir observatory. Main result in Fig. 6 (95% CL).
